$comment: Canonical deny list for agent Bash invocations. Both daemon/pipelines/lib/party-tool-hook.sh (Story 20.3) and daemon/pipelines/lib/free-agent-path-hook.sh (Epic 18) consult this JSON. The party hook stamps explicit case statements from these lists; the free-agent hook does path-confinement and uses the secret_paths + secret_regex_patterns blocks defensively. Update here, regenerate downstream artifacts (a future scripts/build-agent-hooks.mjs generator will automate this).

$gitInlineFlagDanger.reason: git -c lets the agent set arbitrary inline config for one command (e.g. core.hooksPath=/dev/null disables repository hooks; protocol.allow=always bypasses transport restrictions). No legitimate agent use case in this codebase — always deny.

safe_readonly_commands.$comment: Auto-approve. Read-only git, read-only fs, repo introspection. The party hook checks these BEFORE the default-allow fall-through so common commands exit silently without firing the party.tool.default-allow audit event.
